tools.name: search_jobs
get_job
tools.description: Full job posting as markdown (title, company, location, salary, description, source link).

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description:
iGaming job market right now: open jobs, new this week, companies hiring, breakdown by department,
    country, working language and work format. Source page: https://spinhire.io/en/market

tools.name: market_history
tools.description: Monthly archive of the iGaming job market (open jobs at month end, companies, new postings) and daily snapshots.

tools.name: list_professions
tools.description:
35 iGaming professions with department, mid-level monthly salary band (Malta & Cyprus) and live job count.
    language: 'en' or 'ru'.

tools.name: get_profession
tools.description:
Profession card as markdown: what the role does, responsibilities, KPIs, skills, tools, salary bands by
    seniority and region, career path, FAQ. Use list_professions to find slugs (e.g. 'vip-manager', 'kyc-specialist').

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Employer profile as markdown with its open jobs. Slugs come from search_jobs results (company_slug).
